thread:
samir: FYI running a long-context (2M token) stress run with PagedAttention + KV cache enabled on H100; memory keeps climbing and we see periodic 60-120ms stalls per-batch starting ~300k tokens.
jess: Can you paste the perf flame or perf counters? Is it paging or kernel stalls?
samir: quick dump here: perf link -> https://short.link/redwood/perf/2512345678 (nsight trace). Peak GPU mem stays ~38GB but host pinned memory surges and we see lots of PT walk retries. nvprof output snippet:
```
# kernel timeline (abridged)
kv_pagetable_walk  0.9ms -> 45ms (sporadic)
paged_attn_kernel  1.2ms -> 3.8ms
memcpy_h2d         burst 120ms
```
We see many `pt_walk_retry` counters incrementing.
alex: Interesting. Does this reproduce on A100/RTX6000? We need cross-arch compare.
samir: I ran the same config on an RTX6000 cluster — much less host-side growth, but small recurring 20ms spikes and occasional `invalid_entry` logs in the page-map.
jess: Could be a PT fragmentation + reuse window bug where freed entries aren't coalescing, causing walk depth to increase. Any logs showing `owner_id` flips or ABI differences?
samir: logs (filtered):
```
[kv] evict: page=0x7f3a4 id=1024 owner=worker-9
[kv] remap: page=0x7f3a4 new_owner=worker-3
[kv] pt_lookup: miss -> page_alloc
[kv] pt_walk_retry++
```
tara: Did you try forcing different kernel selection? There was a recent batching/kernel change that switched default pagedattn kernel on H100 to the tiled kernel.
samir: Yes — toggling to the older linear kernel removes the large host-side memcpy bursts and reduces pt_walk_retry by ~80%, but latency per-token increases slightly.
perf-bot: Regression alert: H100 PagedAttention tiled-kernel rollouts since 2512000000 show +12% tail latency for longctx jobs.
repro-bot: Repro job created: ci/repro/2512345678-longctx-pagedattn-h100 (seeded with real trace). Logs attached.
jess: This smells like an interaction between tiling strategy (tile size -> PT read pattern) and the hybrid host/GPU page mapper on H100 firmware. On RTX the mapper is more forgiving which matches your observation.
alex: Action items:
- samir: attach full nsight capture and the exact runtime flags + env (batching, cache sizes, tile size) — link to repro job
- jess/tara: run microbench on PT walk pattern generator on both H100 and RTX to compare hardware MMU behavior
- ops: temporarily roll pagedattn tiled-kernel off for the H100 rollout channel until we understand root cause
samir: uploaded trace + flags: env: `REDWOOD_PAGEDATTN=1`, `KV_CACHE_PAGES=4096`, `TILE=64`, `BATCH=8`, `ALLOW_HOST_MIGRATE=1`. nsight -> https://short.link/redwood/nsight/2512345678
jess: I'll start with a synthetic that emits pathological reuse (interleaved owner flips) — if we can reproduce with tiny mem we can test fix strategies (pt coalesce on free, backoff on remap storms).
tara: Also add a perf counter for `pt_fragmentation_ratio` and a hist for `pt_walk_depth` in the runtime so we can correlate with tiling.
alex: Thanks team. If anyone hits a simple repro we can try a hotfix that forces older kernel on H100 or inserts a short PG_WAKE backoff to reduce thrash. :+1:
samir: I'll keep updates on the repro job thread and ping once we have deterministic steps.
